title: trilepis microstachya
intro: Trilepis microstachya, commonly known as 'Gymnema', is a perennial herb native to India, belonging to the Asclepiadaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including diabetes, where it is known to help in reducing blood sugar levels and improving insulin sensitivity. The health benefits of Trilepis microstachya include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gymnemic acid, which is responsible for its therapeutic actions, including reducing glucose absorption in the gut and inhibiting the release of insulin from pancreatic beta cells.
